## 👨 Practical exercise

Make sure you install the latest stable release of [*Cloud Compare*](https://www.cloudcompare.org/) on your laptop. Bring it to the classroom.

Practical on change analysis using *CloudCompare*. Follow instructions [from this video](https://video.univ-rennes1.fr/videos/clouds-2022-comparing-clouds/)

Download two LiDAR data sets for analyzing changes in Kaikōura (New Zealand) [from here](https://opentopography.org/news/post-2016-kaik%C5%8Dura-earthquake-lidar)
